# Traceback Tests Execution

Browse, trigger, and stream cloud-based browser and mobile test executions directly in the terminal.

## Interactive Mode

```sh
traceback tests
```

- Prompts for test type (Web or Mobile).
- Lets you select a test case from the active workspace.
- Resolves the execution environment (e.g. staging vs production).
- Prompts whether to watch the run live with streaming step-by-step logs and status updates.

## Non-Interactive / CI Mode

```sh
traceback tests --test-id <test-id> --environment production --ci --json
```

Use `traceback runs` to view history of past runs and inspect individual execution results.
